definition: Two or more things put together.
examples: Red and blue is a nice combination.
Do you know the combination to the safe?
It's a combination of luck and hard work.

spanish.definition: Dos o más cosas juntas.

definition: A person who is paid to take care of children at home.
examples: The nanny takes the kids to school.
We hired a nanny for the baby.
She worked as a nanny in New York.

spanish.definition: Persona a la que se le paga por cuidar niños en casa.

definition: To grow or to change into something better; to create something new.
examples: The company is developing a new app.
Children develop quickly.
She developed a bad cough.

spanish.definition: Crecer o cambiar a algo mejor; crear algo nuevo.

definition: Very bad or very serious.
examples: He has severe back pain.
There's a severe storm coming.
She had a severe headache.

spanish.definition: Muy malo o muy serio.

definition: Planned well; able to keep things in order.
examples: She's a very organized person.
We went on an organized tour.
My desk is clean and organized.

spanish.definition: Bien planeado; que mantiene las cosas en orden.

definition: Very beautiful or very good.
examples: We had a splendid view of the lake.
What a splendid idea!
They live in a splendid house.

spanish.definition: Muy bonito o muy bueno.

definition: Easy to hurt or attack.
examples: Old people are more vulnerable to the flu.
She felt vulnerable and alone.
Young animals are vulnerable to attack.

spanish.definition: Fácil de lastimar o atacar.

definition: Very important; necessary.
examples: Water is vital for life.
It's vital that you take this medicine.
She played a vital role in the team.

spanish.definition: Muy importante; necesario.

definition: A government office; a piece of furniture with drawers.
examples: He works for the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
She called the travel bureau.
My socks are in the top drawer of the bureau.

spanish.definition: Oficina del gobierno; mueble con cajones.

definition: To move back from danger; a quiet place to rest.
examples: The soldiers had to retreat.
The army retreated to the hills.
They own a mountain retreat.

spanish.definition: Moverse hacia atrás por peligro; lugar tranquilo para descansar.

definition: A vehicle you push in a store; a small vehicle with wheels.
examples: Put the milk in the shopping cart.
He pushed the cart to the car.
We rented a golf cart.

spanish.definition: Vehículo que empujas en una tienda; vehículo pequeño con ruedas.

definition: To tell people something important in public.
examples: They announced their wedding date.
The pilot announced a delay.
The president will announce the news tonight.

spanish.definition: Decir algo importante en público.

definition: A very large group of stars.
examples: Our galaxy is called the Milky Way.
There are billions of galaxies.
The ship came from another galaxy.

spanish.definition: Grupo muy grande de estrellas.

definition: Rings, necklaces and other beautiful things you wear.
examples: She wears a lot of gold jewelry.
They stole her jewelry.
He bought her jewelry for their anniversary.

spanish.definition: Anillos, collares y otras cosas bonitas que te pones.

definition: A man on the day of his wedding.
examples: The groom looked nervous.
The bride and groom danced first.
He's the groom's brother.

spanish.definition: Hombre el día de su boda.

definition: A word you say when you make a small mistake.
examples: Oops, I dropped my phone.
Oops! Sorry about that.
Oops, I sent the wrong email.

spanish.definition: Palabra que dices cuando cometes un error pequeño.

definition: An agreement between countries or groups to work together.
examples: The two countries formed an alliance.
The alliance ended after the war.
Our company made an alliance with a bank.

spanish.definition: Acuerdo entre países o grupos para trabajar juntos.

definition: Similar; in the same way.
examples: The two sisters look alike.
We think alike.
All these houses look alike to me.

spanish.definition: Similar; de la misma forma.

definition: Cooked meat in a round piece of bread.
examples: I'd like a burger and fries.
He made burgers on the grill.
This place has the best burgers in town.

spanish.definition: Carne cocinada dentro de un pan redondo.

definition: A car, ship or plane that is badly damaged; to destroy something.
examples: They found the wreck of a ship.
He wrecked his new car.
She was killed in a car wreck.

spanish.definition: Carro, barco o avión muy dañado; destruir algo.

definition: To think something is good; to officially agree to something.
examples: My parents don't approve of my boyfriend.
The bank approved our loan.
The boss approved the plan.

spanish.definition: Pensar que algo es bueno; aceptar algo oficialmente.

definition: Related to the soul or religion.
examples: She's a very spiritual person.
He's our spiritual leader.
They went on a spiritual journey.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el alma o la religión.

definition: To push a knife into someone or something.
examples: Someone stabbed him in the back.
She stabbed the meat with her fork.
He was stabbed outside a bar.

spanish.definition: Clavar un cuchillo en alguien o algo.

definition: A unit of length equal to 2.54 centimeters.
examples: This phone has a six-inch screen.
He's two inches taller than me.
It snowed ten inches last night.

spanish.definition: Unidad de longitud igual a 2.54 centímetros.

definition: Not expected; surprising.
examples: We had an unexpected visit.
His death was unexpected.
The movie has an unexpected ending.

spanish.definition: Que no se espera; sorprendente.

definition: The moment when someone or something gets to a place.
examples: We're waiting for the arrival of the flight.
Call me on your arrival.
The arrival of the baby changed our lives.

spanish.definition: Momento en que alguien o algo llega a un lugar.

definition: A container made of thin pieces of wood, used to carry things.
examples: She put the bread in a basket.
He scored a basket in the last second.
There's a basket of fruit on the table.

spanish.definition: Recipiente hecho de tiras finas de madera, para llevar cosas.

definition: An event that shocks people because it's wrong.
examples: The scandal ended his career.
There's a new political scandal.
The newspapers loved the scandal.

spanish.definition: Hecho que sorprende a la gente porque está mal.

definition: A large object that soldiers carried for protection.
examples: The soldier held up his shield.
He used his hand as a shield from the sun.
They carried a sword and a shield.

spanish.definition: Objeto grande que los soldados llevaban para protegerse.

definition: Happening right away; a very short time.
examples: We only have instant coffee.
The movie was an instant success.
For an instant, I couldn't speak.

spanish.definition: Que pasa de inmediato; un tiempo muy corto.

definition: Practice for a show or a performance.
examples: We have a rehearsal at six.
The band missed the rehearsal.
The wedding rehearsal is on Friday.

spanish.definition: Práctica para un show o una presentación.

definition: To copy a paper with a machine; to look at something quickly; a medical picture of your body.
examples: Please scan this document.
She scanned the page for her name.
The doctor ordered a brain scan.

spanish.definition: Copiar un papel con una máquina; mirar algo rápido; imagen médica del cuerpo.

definition: Working with computers or electricity.
examples: I bought an electronic dictionary.
She plays electronic music.
We use electronic payment at the store.

spanish.definition: Que funciona con computadoras o electricidad.

definition: A country with an elected leader and no king.
examples: France is a republic.
The new republic has a young president.
The Dominican Republic is in the Caribbean.

spanish.definition: País con un líder elegido y sin rey.

definition: During the night; very quickly.
examples: We stayed overnight at a hotel.
She became famous overnight.
I took an overnight bus.

spanish.word: de la noche a la mañana
spanish.definition: Durante la noche; muy rápido.

definition: Advice; a lawyer in a court.
examples: He asked his father for counsel.
The defense counsel spoke to the jury.
She followed her doctor's counsel.

spanish.definition: Consejo; abogado en un tribunal.

definition: Food used to catch fish or animals.
examples: He put some bait on the hook.
Worms are good bait for fish.
They used cheese as bait for the mouse.

spanish.definition: Comida para atrapar peces o animales.

definition: The quality of being respected and calm.
examples: She lost her job but kept her dignity.
Everyone deserves dignity.
He accepted his defeat with dignity.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser respetado y mantener la calma.

definition: Talk about other people's private lives; to talk about others.
examples: I don't like office gossip.
They're gossiping about the new neighbor.
Don't believe that gossip.

spanish.definition: Hablar de la vida privada de otros; hablar de los demás.

definition: Not thinking you are better than others.
examples: He's a very humble man.
She comes from a humble family.
Stay humble, even when you win.

spanish.definition: Que no se cree mejor que los demás.

definition: The money, business and jobs of a country.
examples: The economy is growing.
Tourism is important for our economy.
The country's economy is very weak.

spanish.definition: Dinero, negocios y empleos de un país.

definition: Thin, soft paper for your nose; the material that forms the body.
examples: Can I have a tissue?
He wiped his nose with a tissue.
The doctor removed the damaged tissue.

spanish.definition: Papel suave y delgado para la nariz; material que forma el cuerpo.

definition: To hit something by accident; a small round area on your skin or on the road.
examples: I bumped my head on the door.
He has a bump on his head.
The car hit a bump in the road.

spanish.definition: Golpear algo sin querer; parte redonda y pequeña en la piel o el camino.

definition: The highest or the most important.
examples: The Supreme Court made its decision.
He's the supreme leader of the country.
She made a supreme effort to finish.

spanish.definition: El más alto o el más importante.

definition: A game where you mark numbers on a card; a word you say when you win.
examples: My grandmother plays bingo on Tuesdays.
Bingo! I found my keys.
We won a prize at bingo.

spanish.definition: Juego en que marcas números en una tarjeta; palabra que dices al ganar.

definition: A feeling of being very happy and full of energy.
examples: The kids couldn't sleep from excitement.
There was excitement in the air.
She jumped with excitement.

spanish.definition: Sensación de estar muy feliz y lleno de energía.

definition: All people in the world.
examples: The moon landing was a big step for mankind.
War is the worst thing in the history of mankind.
This discovery will help all mankind.

spanish.definition: Todas las personas del mundo.

definition: A ship or a large boat; a tube that carries blood.
examples: The vessel left the port at dawn.
He has a damaged blood vessel.
A fishing vessel saved them.

spanish.definition: Barco grande; tubo que lleva sangre.

definition: Very dirty or smelling very bad; an action against the rules in sports.
examples: There's a foul smell in the kitchen.
The referee called a foul.
He's in a foul mood today.

spanish.definition: Muy sucio o con muy mal olor; acción contra las reglas en un deporte.

definition: A part of something; a basic substance such as gold or oxygen.
examples: Trust is a key element in any relationship.
Gold is a chemical element.
There's an element of risk in this job.

spanish.definition: Parte de algo; sustancia básica como el oro o el oxígeno.

definition: A long sleep after a serious illness or injury.
examples: He's been in a coma for two weeks.
She woke up from the coma.
The accident left him in a coma.

spanish.definition: Sueño largo después de una enfermedad o lesión grave.

definition: The box for a dead person.
examples: They carried the coffin to the church.
The coffin was made of dark wood.
There were flowers on the coffin.

spanish.definition: Caja para una persona muerta.

definition: A young dog.
examples: We got a puppy for Christmas.
The puppy is sleeping on my bed.
Look at those cute puppies!

spanish.definition: Perro joven.

definition: Something important you tell people in public.
examples: I have an announcement to make.
The announcement surprised everyone.
They made the announcement at the airport.

spanish.definition: Algo importante que dices en público.

definition: A serious, formal promise.
examples: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.
The president took the oath on a Bible.
Doctors take an oath to help people.

spanish.definition: Promesa seria y formal.

definition: Money you pay first or put in a bank; to put money in a bank.
examples: We paid a deposit on the apartment.
I deposited the check this morning.
You'll get your deposit back.

spanish.definition: Dinero que pagas primero o pones en un banco; poner dinero en un banco.

definition: Money you must pay to the government; to charge this money.
examples: We pay too much tax.
The price doesn't include tax.
The government taxes cigarettes.

spanish.definition: Dinero que debes pagar al gobierno; cobrar ese dinero.

definition: To tell someone what you think they should do.
examples: The doctor advised me to rest.
I advise you to call a lawyer.
She's advising the president.

spanish.definition: Decirle a alguien lo que crees que debe hacer.

definition: A talk to a group of students; a long, serious talk to someone who did wrong.
examples: I have a lecture at nine.
Don't give me a lecture about money.
The professor gave a lecture on art.

spanish.definition: Charla a un grupo de estudiantes; charla larga a quien hizo algo mal.

definition: Very thin.
examples: He's tall and skinny.
She was a skinny little girl.
I bought skinny jeans.

spanish.definition: Muy delgado.

definition: To have something as a part of a group or a total.
examples: The price includes breakfast.
Don't forget to include your name.
The tour included a visit to the museum.

spanish.definition: Tener algo como parte de un grupo o un total.

definition: Help.
examples: Do you need any assistance?
Call us for assistance.
She asked for financial assistance.

spanish.definition: Ayuda que se da a alguien.

definition: Alone; a piece of music for one person.
examples: She took a solo trip to Peru.
He played a guitar solo.
I prefer to travel solo.

spanish.definition: Sin compañía; pieza de música para una persona.

definition: To find out; to decide.
examples: The police are trying to determine the cause of the fire.
Your grades determine your future.
Doctors determined the cause of death.

spanish.definition: Averiguar; decidir.

definition: An object that gives light.
examples: Turn on the lamp.
She has a lamp next to her bed.
The lamp in the living room is broken.

spanish.definition: Objeto que da luz.

definition: Useful; dealing with real situations.
examples: She gave me some practical advice.
It's a very practical car for a family.
He's a practical man.

spanish.definition: Útil; relacionado con situaciones reales.

definition: Very cute.
examples: Your baby is adorable.
What an adorable little dog!
She looks adorable in that hat.

spanish.definition: Muy lindo.

definition: A soft material that can stretch, used for tires.
examples: Tires are made of rubber.
She's wearing rubber boots.
The kids play with a rubber ball.

spanish.definition: Material suave que se estira, usado para llantas.

definition: The color you get when you mix red and blue.
examples: She's wearing a purple dress.
Purple is my favorite color.
The sky turned purple at sunset.

spanish.definition: Color que resulta al mezclar rojo y azul.

definition: A set of rooms in a hotel.
examples: We stayed in a suite on the top floor.
The hotel gave us a suite for free.
The president's suite has three bedrooms.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de habitaciones en un hotel.

definition: The people who work in a company or in the army.
examples: Only medical personnel can enter.
The hotel personnel were very kind.
Talk to the personnel office.

spanish.definition: Personas que trabajan en una empresa o en el ejército.

definition: A line of light; a long, heavy piece of wood or metal.
examples: A beam of light came through the window.
The roof has wooden beams.
The steel beam fell to the ground.

spanish.definition: Línea de luz; pieza larga y pesada de madera o metal.

definition: A person who writes poems.
examples: Pablo Neruda was a great poet.
She's a young poet from Boston.
The poet read his work aloud.

spanish.definition: Persona que escribe poemas.

definition: A thin stick you shoot with a bow; a sign that shows a direction.
examples: Follow the arrows to the exit.
The arrow hit the target.
Click on the arrow to continue.

spanish.definition: Palo delgado que se dispara con un arco; signo que muestra una dirección.

definition: A person whose job is to help people with problems or advice.
examples: She talked to the school counselor.
We saw a marriage counselor.
My son is a camp counselor this summer.

spanish.definition: Persona cuyo trabajo es ayudar con problemas o consejos.

definition: A thick cloth that covers a floor.
examples: We have a new carpet in the bedroom.
He spilled coffee on the carpet.
She walked down the red carpet.

spanish.definition: Tela gruesa que cubre el piso.

definition: A person who writes news.
examples: She's a journalist for a big newspaper.
The journalist asked a hard question.
He wants to become a journalist.

spanish.definition: Persona que escribe noticias.

definition: A person who answers calls or who uses a machine.
examples: The operator put me on hold.
Call the operator for help.
He's a crane operator.

spanish.definition: Persona que contesta llamadas o usa una máquina.

definition: To need or trust someone or something.
examples: You can rely on me.
We rely on tourists for our income.
She relied on her sister for help.

spanish.definition: Necesitar o confiar en alguien o algo.

definition: In or from the east.
examples: New York is in the eastern part of the U.S.
We traveled through Eastern Europe.
The storm will reach the eastern coast.

spanish.definition: En el este o que viene del este.

definition: To cut hair from your face or body with a blade.
examples: He shaves every morning.
I forgot to shave today.
She shaved her head for charity.

spanish.definition: Cortar el pelo de la cara o del cuerpo con una cuchilla.

definition: To throw something lightly.
examples: He tossed the keys to me.
She tossed the paper in the trash.
Toss the salad before you serve it.

spanish.definition: Tirar algo suavemente.

definition: A strong chemical that can burn things.
examples: The acid burned a hole in the table.
Lemons contain citric acid.
Be careful, that's battery acid.

spanish.definition: Químico fuerte que puede quemar cosas.

definition: With a name that nobody knows.
examples: The police got an anonymous call.
She made an anonymous donation.
The writer wants to remain anonymous.

spanish.definition: Con un nombre que nadie conoce.

definition: Coming after the fifth.
examples: We live on the sixth floor.
She's in the sixth grade.
Today is the sixth of March.

spanish.definition: Que viene después del quinto.

definition: A mistake.
examples: There's an error in your report.
The computer showed an error message.
It was a human error.

spanish.definition: Equivocación al hacer algo.

definition: A person who shares a room or an apartment with you.
examples: My roommate is from Texas.
I'm looking for a new roommate.
She and her roommate get along well.

spanish.definition: Persona que comparte un cuarto o apartamento contigo.

definition: A person who goes to see a person or place.
examples: The museum gets many visitors.
We had some visitors last night.
Visitors must sign in at the front desk.

spanish.definition: Persona que va a ver a alguien o un lugar.

definition: A promise to do something; loyal effort.
examples: Marriage is a big commitment.
I have a work commitment on Friday.
She shows real commitment to her students.

spanish.definition: Promesa de hacer algo; esfuerzo leal.

definition: To do or say something because of something that happened.
examples: How did your mother react?
He reacted badly to the news.
She didn't react to the joke.

spanish.definition: Hacer o decir algo por algo que pasó.

definition: A public action to show that you don't agree with something.
examples: There was a big protest in the capital.
Thousands of people joined the protest.
He quit in protest.

spanish.definition: Acción pública para mostrar que no estás de acuerdo con algo.

definition: Great unhappiness or pain.
examples: War brings misery to many families.
He lived a life of misery.
Please put me out of my misery.

spanish.definition: Gran infelicidad o dolor.

definition: To put your arms around someone; to accept something happily.
examples: They embraced at the airport.
He held her in a warm embrace.
She embraced the new idea.

spanish.definition: Rodear a alguien con los brazos; aceptar algo con alegría.

definition: To share information or feelings with someone.
examples: We communicate by email.
They need to communicate better.
She can communicate in three languages.

spanish.definition: Compartir información o sentimientos con alguien.

definition: Loyal; staying with someone.
examples: He has a faithful dog.
She's always been faithful to her husband.
They're faithful friends.

spanish.definition: Leal; que se queda con alguien.

definition: The bright, hot part of a fire.
examples: The house was in flames.
Keep the paper away from the flame.
She lit the candle and watched the flame.

spanish.definition: Parte brillante y caliente del fuego.

definition: A small metal prize you get for winning or being brave.
examples: She won a gold medal.
The soldier got a medal.
He showed me his Olympic medal.

spanish.definition: Premio pequeño de metal que ganas por vencer o por ser valiente.

definition: A very soft, smooth cloth.
examples: She wore a silk dress.
This scarf is made of silk.
He bought silk sheets.

spanish.definition: Tela muy suave y lisa.

definition: A place where dead people are buried.
examples: My grandfather is buried in this cemetery.
They walked through the old cemetery.
There's a cemetery behind the church.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde se entierra a los muertos.

definition: The back part of something.
examples: Use the rear door.
He sat in the rear of the bus.
The rear window is broken.

spanish.definition: Parte de atrás de algo.
